name: filesystem
description: Filesystem MCP server with P1 Read-After-Edit enforcement

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read complete file content. Mandatory after any write_file (Regla P1).

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to file. MUST be followed by read_file in the same turn to verify the diff (Regla P1).

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Glob-pattern search; replaces fragile shell grep.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Stat: size, mtime, mode, hash SHA-256.
